terms_note: Register on open.e.360.cn (欢迎注册360), create an application in the developer center, obtain API credentials; docs under 技术文档 (link target returned 404 for the guessed path). Rate limits unknown. Free.

discovery.auth: token (点睛营销开放平台 developer app credentials — TODO(verify))

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (360点睛营销开放平台 API for third-party tools).
auth: 1. Register at open.e.360.cn; create an application in 开发者中心 (application listed in 应用列表 once approved).
2. Obtain API credentials (apiKey / accessToken — TODO(verify)) and call the 点睛 search-promotion services.
3. Advertisers grant the tool access from their 点睛 account.
reference.limits: - Rate limits unknown; access by developer registration and app approval; free API.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: ApiKey e-mailed after the open.e.360.cn developer application is approved; sent as the `apiKey` HTTP header on every call.

fields.name: encrypted_password
fields.help: clientLogin `passwd`: AES-CBC(MD5(password)) with key = first 16 characters of the ApiSecret and IV = last 16, as 64 lowercase hex characters (身份认证: '秘钥是apiSecret 的前16位，向量是后16位'). It is a fixed value, so compute it once with 360's official 'openAPI登录接口AES调试工具' or its code samples; the password itself is never needed. Five wrong logins lock the account until the next day.

me.note: POST uc/account/getInfo (headers apiKey + accessToken) → uid, userName, balance, budget … of the logged-in account.

get_report.note: POST dianjing/report/campaign (form startDate, endDate, type=all, page) — settled campaign report, at most 90 days and up to yesterday (ready after ~08:30 Beijing time; error 70109 before that), 1000 rows per page. The account is the logged-in one (`account_id` is not sent) and `campaign_id` is not a documented filter. spend is totalCost in CNY.

update_budget.note: POST dianjing/campaign/update (form id, budget): budget is the campaign's daily budget in whole CNY (0 = unlimited; a fractional amount is rejected before sending). This changes spend. `currency` is ignored.

pause_resume.note: POST dianjing/campaign/update (form id, status=pause|enable). Resuming restarts spend.

not_offered.list_accounts: clientLogin issues a token for one 点睛 account ('作为操作对应广告账户的凭证', https://open.e.360.cn/api/account_clientLogin.html); listing accounts (account_getmccuserlist) needs the separate agency managerLogin flow.
not_offered.list_campaigns: Campaign details come in two calls: getCampaignIdList returns only a bare id array ('campaignIdList: 推广计划id数组', https://open.e.360.cn/api/campaign_getCampaignIdList.html) and campaign/getInfoByIdList needs those ids ('idList … json格式的id数组', https://open.e.360.cn/api/campaign_getInfoByIdList.html); a single adapter call cannot chain them and the runtime keeps only object rows.

evidence: host api.e.360.cn: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (WoTrus CA Limited)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
